wandavoice-api-error-disabled: API error message shown when the WandaVoice extension is disabled via configuration.
wandavoice-api-error-empty: API error message shown when the command parameter is empty.
wandavoice-api-error-llm-disabled: API error message shown when LLM intent recognition is disabled via configuration.
wandavoice-api-error-llm-unavailable: API error message shown when the internal request to Wanda's LLM fails.
wandavoice-api-error-stt-disabled: API error message shown when no server-side speech-to-text endpoint is configured.
wandavoice-api-error-stt-toolarge: API error message shown when the uploaded audio clip exceeds the configured size limit.
wandavoice-api-error-stt-badaudio: API error message shown when the uploaded audio data cannot be decoded or has an unsupported MIME type.
wandavoice-api-error-stt-failed: API error message shown when the external speech-to-text service returns an error or an empty transcript.
wandavoice-panel-title:
Title of the floating voice control panel.
{{Identical|WandaVoice}}
wandavoice-button-aria-start: Accessible label of the microphone button when voice control is off.
wandavoice-button-aria-stop: Accessible label of the microphone button when voice control is on.
wandavoice-status-idle: Status text shown when voice control is off.
wandavoice-status-wake:
Status text shown while passively listening for the wake phrase. Parameters:
* $1 - the configured wake phrase (e.g. "Wanda")
wandavoice-status-listening: Status text shown while actively recording a command.
wandavoice-status-processing: Status text shown while a command is being interpreted.
wandavoice-status-dictation: Status text shown while dictation mode is active.
wandavoice-status-unsupported: Status text shown when the browser does not support the Web Speech API.
wandavoice-transcript-label: Label shown before the transcribed text of what the user said.
wandavoice-thinking-title: Heading of the list of command interpretation steps.
wandavoice-help-button: Label of the button that shows example voice commands.
wandavoice-help-title: Heading of the example voice commands help section.
wandavoice-help-commands: A list of example voice commands, separated by middle dots. Translate the example phrases.
wandavoice-close:
Label of the button that closes the voice status panel.
{{Identical|Close}}
wandavoice-error-nosupport: Error message shown when the browser does not support speech recognition.
wandavoice-error-mic-denied: Error message shown when the user denied microphone access.
wandavoice-error-generic: Generic error message shown when processing a voice command fails.
wandavoice-error-unknown: Error message spoken and shown when a voice command was not understood.
wandavoice-error-noeditor: Error message shown when an editing command is used but no editor is open.
wandavoice-feedback-listening-on: Spoken confirmation when voice control is switched on.
wandavoice-feedback-listening-off: Spoken confirmation when voice control is switched off.
wandavoice-feedback-wake: Spoken confirmation when the wake phrase was detected.
wandavoice-feedback-navigating:
Spoken confirmation before navigating. Parameters:
* $1 - the target page title
wandavoice-feedback-searching:
Spoken confirmation before searching. Parameters:
* $1 - the search terms
wandavoice-feedback-editing:
Spoken confirmation before opening a section for editing. Parameters:
* $1 - the section name or number
* $2 - the page title
wandavoice-feedback-editpage:
Spoken confirmation before opening a whole page for editing. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
wandavoice-feedback-history:
Spoken confirmation before opening the page history. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
wandavoice-feedback-inserted: Spoken confirmation after text or markup was inserted into the editor.
wandavoice-feedback-formatted:
Spoken confirmation after formatting was applied. Parameters:
* $1 - the formatting style ("bold" or "italic")
wandavoice-feedback-saved: Spoken confirmation when the page is being saved.
wandavoice-feedback-previewing: Spoken confirmation when the preview is being shown.
wandavoice-feedback-undone: Spoken confirmation after the last voice edit was undone.
wandavoice-feedback-nothing-to-undo: Message shown when undo is requested but there is nothing to undo.
wandavoice-feedback-cancelled:
Spoken confirmation after the current operation was cancelled.
{{Identical|Cancelled}}
wandavoice-feedback-dictation-on: Spoken confirmation when dictation mode is enabled.
wandavoice-feedback-dictation-off: Spoken confirmation when dictation mode is disabled.
wandavoice-feedback-resume: Message shown after a multi-step voice command continued on a newly loaded page.
wandavoice-feedback-page-not-found:
Spoken message when a page could not be resolved. Parameters:
* $1 - the spoken page name
wandavoice-feedback-no-permission:
Spoken message when the user lacks edit permission. Parameters:
* $1 - the page title
wandavoice-section-introduction: Name used for the lead section (section 0) of a page in spoken feedback.
wandavoice-section-number:
Name used for a section referenced by number in spoken feedback. Parameters:
* $1 - the section number
